mcp:tool-listener.name: approval-request
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Based on triggered request, an approval request will be sent for confirming the ticket.

mcp:enum-schema-property.name: approve-request
mcp:enum-schema-property.description: Is the created tickets good to send this for Manager Approval?

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var isApproved = (payload.content["approve-request"] ~= "Approve") --- { sendRequestToManager: isApproved, approvalRequested: isApproved, approvalAction: payload.action, status: if(isApproved) "PENDING_MANAGER_APPROVAL" else payload.action, message: if(isApproved) "Sending Request to Manager Approval" else if(payload.action == "decline") "Approval was declined; no manager approval request was sent" else "Approval was canceled; no manager approval request was sent", managerSlackId: "", ticketIds: vars.originalPayload.ticketIds, ticketUrls: vars.originalPayload.ticketUrls, canvasUrl: vars.originalPayload.canvasUrl, requestedBySlackId: vars.originalPayload.requestedBySlackId }
